The construction site was closed after 8pm.
Between what times could Sarah have gone to the construction site?

Options:
(A) 3pm to 4pm
(B) 2pm to 3pm
(C) 6am to 8am
(D) 8am to 2pm

Think step by step about the question. Keep reasoning concise (under 300 words). Then give your final answer on the last line in exactly this format: Answer: (X)
